Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting royalty income on patents and copyrights from business and occupation tax for five years.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation taxation ofroyalties; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; providing aneffective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to amounts receivedas royalties for copyrights or patents for five years, beginning withthe date the copyright is registered or patent is filed. This sectionapplies to royalties received for copyrights registered or patentsissued after June 30, 2005. (2) "Royalties" means compensation for the use of copyrights orpatents.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effect p. 1 SSB 5640July 1, 2005.
